query: WITH scope_tracks(track_id) AS ( SELECT entity_id FROM user_library WHERE user_id = ? AND entity_kind = 'track' UNION SELECT entity_id FROM user_feedback WHERE user_id = ? AND entity_kind = 'track' AND value = 'like' UNION SELECT pt.track_id FROM playlist_tracks pt JOIN playlists p ON p.id = pt.playlist_id WHERE p.owner_user_id = ? AND p.is_temporary = 0 UNION SELECT mf.track_id FROM media_files mf JOIN library_folders lf ON lf.id = mf.folder_id WHERE mf.storage = 'folder' AND lf.owner_user_id = ? UNION SELECT t.id FROM tracks t WHERE t.album_id IN ( SELECT entity_id FROM user_library WHERE user_id = ? AND entity_kind = 'album' UNION SELECT entity_id FROM user_feedback WHERE user_id = ? AND entity_kind = 'album' AND value = 'like') ) SELECT al.id, al.title, al.sort_title, al.display_artist, al.year, al.release_date, al.album_type, al.mb_release_id, al.mb_release_group_id, al.upc, al.edition, al.origin, al.created_at, al.updated_at FROM albums al WHERE (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM album_artists aa WHERE aa.album_id = al.id AND aa.artist_id = ?) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tracks t JOIN track_artists ta ON ta.track_id = t.id WHERE t.album_id = al.id AND ta.artist_id = ?)) AND (al.id IN (SELECT t.album_id FROM tracks t JOIN scope_tracks st ON st.track_id = t.id) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM user_library WHERE user_id = ? AND entity_kind = 'album' AND entity_id = al.id) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM user_feedback WHERE user_id = ? AND entity_kind = 'album' AND value = 'like' AND entity_id = al.id)) ORDER BY al.year IS NULL, al.year, al.sort_title, al.id
